tasks.check: deno check --config deno.json tools/deno/frontend.ts tools/deno/dev.ts server/serve.ts tools/deno/check.ts tools/deno/build-backend.ts tools/deno/package.ts tools/deno/windows-single.ts tools/deno/app-suite-runner.ts && deno run --config deno.json -A tools/deno/check.ts
tasks.build: deno task check && deno run --config deno.json -A tools/deno/frontend.ts build && deno run --config deno.json -A tools/deno/build-backend.ts && deno check --config desktop/deno.json desktop/main.ts desktop/backend.test.ts desktop/desktop-address.test.ts
tasks.test:desktop: deno task build && deno test --config desktop/deno.json --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-net=127.0.0.1 desktop/backend.test.ts desktop/desktop-address.test.ts
tasks.desktop: deno task build && deno desktop --config desktop/deno.json --backend webview --hmr --no-code-cache --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-net=127.0.0.1 --no-prompt desktop/main.ts
tasks.package: deno task build && deno run --config deno.json -A tools/deno/package.ts
